plan.title: bug(issue-eval,windows): triage:evaluate session:start --read-only ENOENTs on npm .cmd shims

narratives.Description: task triage:evaluate spawns bare deft via execFileSync so Windows npm deft.cmd is ENOENT. Resolve deft/directive with PATHEXT-aware PATH scan and cliSpawnPlan; keep runText shell-false.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`task triage:evaluate` cannot start its isolated evaluator on Windows. The parent worktree is created, then `session:start --read-only` is spawned as a bare `deft` argv0. Node `execFileSync` does not resolve the npm global `deft.cmd` / `deft.ps1` shim, so the evaluator dies with `spawnSync deft ENOENT` and the validity stamp stays `null`.

This is a consumer hard stop on the documented Stage A issue-eval flow. Interactive `deft` in the same PowerShell works.

## Reproduction

Host: win32, PowerShell. Global CLI present:

```text
where.exe deft
C:\Users\msada\AppData\Roaming\npm\deft
C:\Users\msada\AppData\Roaming\npm\deft.cmd
```

Against origin/master `3d8b42438d00`:

```text
task triage:evaluate -- 3993 --json
```

Observed (2026-09-02, deftai/directive, evaluating #3993):

```text
"validity": null
"error": "session:start --read-only failed in C:/Repos/deft/directive/.deft-scratch/worktrees/issue-eval-3993-f0ac158c-bfde-4357-a5e7-009bd701a223: spawnSync deft ENOENT"
```

Call site:

```ts
// packages/core/src/triage/evaluate/evaluate.ts
runText(["deft", "session:start", "--read-only"], { cwd: worktreePath })
```

```ts
// packages/core/src/swarm/subprocess.ts
execFileSync(binary, args, { cwd, encoding: "utf8", ... })
```

`evaluate.test.ts` stubs `sessionStart`, so this path has no Windows coverage.

## Why this is a recurrence

#2606 is the same ENOENT class (`spawnSync deft ENOENT` despite a working global npm install). That fix landed in `defaultEngineProbe` (doctor/update). `runText` / issue-eval did not take it.

#3648 shipped `triage:evaluate` with a hardcoded `deft` spawn. Nearby PATHEXT / `.cmd` work (#721, #2467, #2548, #2415) also did not reach this helper.

Do not copy `shell: true`. #2911 forbids that on win32 free-text argv.

## Suggested thin fix

Resolve `deft` / `directive` with the existing PATHEXT-aware PATH scan (`whichAllFromPath` in `packages/core/src/doctor/which.ts`), then spawn the absolute shim through `cliSpawnPlan` (`cmd.exe /d /s /c` + quoted tokens on win32). Keep `runText` shell-false.

Add a test that the default session-start spawn plan resolves `deft.cmd` on win32 instead of a bare `deft` argv0.

## Consumer hard-stop evidence

Required for `adoption-blocker` (`content/scm/github.md`):

1. **Affected consumer flow and version.** Documented Stage A issue-eval: `task triage:evaluate -- <N>` on Windows. Observed on origin/master `3d8b42438d00` (2026-09-02) with a working global npm `deft.cmd`. Intended flow: isolated origin/master validity stamp. Actual: evaluate exits 1, `validity` is `null`.
2. **Documented alternatives.** There is no documented Windows workaround for this verb. Interactive `deft` in the same shell succeeds and is not a substitute: issue-eval still spawns `deft` via `execFileSync`. Switching to Git Bash or injecting `sessionStart` is not a reasonable consumer workaround.
3. **Observed recovery cost.** One evaluate invocation failed closed. Isolated validity had to be reconstructed by a manual origin/master code read to finish analysis of #3993. Stage A is unusable on this Windows host until the spawn is fixed.
4. **Triage owner and date.** Scott, 2026-09-02. Privileged label apply after this body-evidence test.

## References

#2606, #3648, #2911, #2548, #2467, #721, #2415
narratives.UserStory: As a Windows maintainer, I want triage:evaluate to spawn the npm deft.cmd shim, so that Stage A issue-eval can stamp validity.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Resolve deft/directive with whichAllFromPath in packages/core/src/doctor/which.ts then spawn via cliSpawnPlan (cmd.exe /d /s /c quoted tokens on win32) from packages/core/src/triage/evaluate/evaluate.ts and swarm/subprocess.ts.
- Keep runText shell-false. Do not copy shell:true (#2911).
- Add a test that the default session-start spawn plan resolves deft.cmd on win32. CHANGELOG Unreleased.
